en.name: Soft pretzel, fresh-baked
en.summary: A fresh lye-dipped soft pretzel is a same-morning food: 4–12 hours at room temperature, unwrapped. Do not refrigerate it. Frozen at −18 °C (0 °F) it holds 1–2 months, and reheating from frozen is the only thing that genuinely brings it back.
en.pantry: 4–12 hours, unwrapped, and it deteriorates faster than any other bread on this site. Two things work against it at once. The lye bath leaves a thin, deeply browned skin that goes leathery the moment the crumb's moisture migrates outward, and the coarse salt on top is hygroscopic — it pulls water out of the air and dissolves into wet patches. Wrapping makes it soggy; not wrapping makes it dry, so there is no winning move except eating it. This figure is our own quality judgement, not a published number and not a safety limit: a day-old pretzel is perfectly safe, it is just no longer worth eating.
en.fridge: No. Cold accelerates staling in a lean dough — starch retrogradation runs fastest just above freezing — and a pretzel is about as lean as bread gets, with no fat or sugar to buffer it. The fridge would only be worth considering in a hot humid kitchen where mould wins first, and a pretzel goes leathery long before it moulds, so that trade never arrives. No refrigerated timeline is given here for exactly that reason.
en.freezer: 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F), and it is the one thing that works. Freeze them the hour they cool, bagged with the air pressed out, and reheat from frozen in a hot oven for six to eight minutes; brush with a little water and re-salt if the salt has dissolved. Kept continuously frozen they stay safe well beyond that — the window describes drying and freezer burn, not safety. Commercially frozen pretzels are a different, purpose-packed product and keep far longer.
en.thawing: Reheat from frozen in a hot oven. Do not thaw first: a thawed pretzel is limp, and the salt will already have drawn water to the surface.
spoilage: A skin gone leathery and bendy instead of thin and crisp.
Wet, glassy patches where the coarse salt has dissolved.
A dry, dense crumb that no longer pulls apart in strands.
Mould spots, which only appear on a pretzel kept far past its useful life.
tips: Buy them the number you will eat that morning; there is no good way to keep one.
Leave them uncovered — a bag turns the lye skin soft within the hour.
Freeze the surplus the hour it cools rather than at the end of the day.
Brush with water and add fresh coarse salt when reheating from frozen.

faq.q: How long does a fresh soft pretzel stay good?
faq.a: 4–12 hours at room temperature, unwrapped. It stays safe far longer than that; it just stops being good.
Yes, 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze them the hour they cool and reheat straight from frozen in a hot oven, with a brush of water and fresh salt.

faq.q: Should you keep pretzels in the fridge?
faq.a: No. Cold speeds up staling in a lean dough like this, and a pretzel goes leathery long before mould would ever become the problem.

zh.name: 德式鹼水扭結麵包
zh.summary: 剛出爐的鹼水扭結麵包是「當天早上」的食物：室溫不包、4～12 小時。不要冷藏。−18 °C 冷凍可放 1～2 個月，而從冷凍直接回烤是唯一真正救得回來的方法。
zh.pantry: 不要包，室溫 4～12 小時；它退步的速度比本站任何一種麵包都快。有兩件事同時在跟它作對：鹼水浴留下的那層薄而深褐的外皮，只要內裡的水分往外跑就立刻變得韌韌的；而表面的粗鹽會吸濕——它從空氣裡抓水，然後化成一塊一塊的濕斑。包起來會變軟爛，不包會變乾，所以除了趕快吃掉之外沒有別的解法。這個數字是我們自己的品質判斷，不是公布的數據，也不是安全期限：放了一天的鹼水結完全安全，只是不值得吃了。
zh.fridge: 不要。低溫會加速瘦麵團的老化——澱粉回凝在略高於冰點時最快——而鹼水結大概是最瘦的麵包，沒有油脂也沒有糖可以緩衝。只有在又熱又濕、霉會先贏的廚房裡才需要考慮冷藏，而鹼水結在長霉之前老早就韌掉了，所以那個交換根本輪不到。這裡不給冷藏期限，原因正是如此。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 1～2 個月，而這是唯一行得通的辦法。放涼的那一小時內裝袋、壓掉空氣冷凍，要吃時直接從冷凍進高溫烤箱烤六到八分鐘；表面刷一點水，鹽化掉了就補撒一點粗鹽。只要全程沒退冰就一直是安全的——這個期限描述的是變乾和凍燒，不是安全。市售冷凍鹼水結是另一種為冷凍而設計的產品，可以放得久得多。
zh.thawing: 直接從冷凍進高溫烤箱。不要先解凍：解凍過的鹼水結會軟塌，而且鹽早就把水拉到表面來了。
spoilage: 外皮變得韌而可彎，不再是薄而脆的狀態。
粗鹽化掉的地方出現濕濕亮亮的斑塊。
內裡變乾變密，撕不出組織感。
長霉——那只會出現在遠遠放過頭的鹼水結上。
tips: 當天早上吃得完幾個就買幾個；它沒有好的保存方式。
不要蓋、不要裝袋——一個袋子一小時內就能把鹼皮悶軟。
多的請在放涼那一小時內就冷凍，不要等到晚上。
從冷凍回烤時刷點水、補撒新的粗鹽。

faq.q: 現烤鹼水扭結麵包可以放多久？
faq.a: 室溫不包、4～12 小時。它在安全上可以放久得多，只是已經不好吃了。

faq.q: 鹼水扭結麵包可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下 1～2 個月。放涼那一小時內冷凍，要吃時直接從冷凍進高溫烤箱，刷水、補鹽。

faq.q: 鹼水扭結麵包可以放冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 不要。低溫會加速這種瘦麵團的老化，而且它在長霉之前早就先變韌了。
